family_mismatch.note: mismatch activity for the 'other' family is not independently verified for PDK family 'gf180mcu'; treat any sampled spread for it as unconfirmed.

MOS per-instance mismatch (the fets_mm include) is gated by the model-level sw_stat_mismatch switch and scales the per-device delvto/mulu0 terms -- active whenever that switch is set (see docs/cli/sim.md's 'Known-good mismatch mechanisms').

The MIM-capacitor subcircuits (cap_mim_*) reference only the global sw_stat_global terms (one draw per run shared by every instance); sw_stat_mismatch is not referenced inside them, so no per-instance capacitor mismatch is sampled. See issue #2898.

The poly-resistor subcircuits' per-instance mismatch hook (mis_r, scaling body resistance via `(1 + mis_r * <switch>)`) defaults to a hardcoded 0, and the accompanying Pelgrom-style sigma formula ships commented out in the vendored deck -- resistor mismatch is structurally disabled regardless of sw_stat_mismatch. A run with mismatch enabled samples no resistor variation. See issue #355.
